summary: The failures point to reversed high and low words in floating-point construction: values below 2^64 land in the high word, and larger values have their words exchanged. Please provide the current MakeUint128 contract and implementation to confirm the repair target.
hypotheses: MakeUint128FromFloat passes its low word as the high-word argument and its high word as the low-word argument, corrupting float, double, and long-double conversions.
